name: uz.birinchishop/shop
title: Birinchi Shop — Uzbekistan store
description: Shop products in Uzbekistan: search, prices with delivery, cash-on-delivery orders, order status.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Search the store catalog. Returns title, price (UZS), delivery fee, availability, url and image. Product names are in Uzbek or Russian; short keywords in either language match best, with the specific product type kept ("smart soat" returns smartwatches, "soat" returns every kind of watch).
Example: {"query": "soat", "max_price": 300000, "sort": "price_asc", "limit": 5} — watches up to 300 000 UZS, cheapest first.

sort.description: Result order. Omit for the default (popular first).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description:
Full product details: description, all images, video, variants (size/color with their own price and availability), delivery terms and the total to pay.
Example: {"product_id": 1234} — the id comes from a search_products result.

tools.name: store_info
tools.description:
The store's official policies: delivery area (Uzbekistan only), delivery time and fee, payment (cash to the courier on delivery; no cards or online payments), how orders are confirmed by phone, inspection on delivery, returns and the support contact. Answers questions about how delivery, payment and returns work.
Example: {} — takes no arguments.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description:
Places a real cash-on-delivery order for the shopper. A call-center operator phones the given number to confirm, then a courier delivers and collects payment. The order is accepted only with customer_confirmed=true, meaning the shopper explicitly confirmed the product, variant, total and phone number.
Example (sample values): {"product_id": 1234, "variant_id": 56, "customer_name": "Ali Valiyev", "customer_phone": "+998900000000", "region": "Toshkent", "customer_confirmed": true, "agent": "Claude"}.

product_id.description: Product id from search_products or get_product.

variant_id.description: Required if the product has variants; variant ids are listed in the product details.

variant_type_id.description: Required if the chosen variant has types.

customer_name.description: Shopper's name for the courier, as they gave it.

customer_confirmed.description: Must be true: the shopper explicitly confirmed this order.

agent.description: Name of the assistant placing the order, e.g. "ChatGPT".

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description:
Status of an order placed earlier. Requires the order id and the last 4 digits of the customer's phone.
Example: {"order_id": 100500, "phone_last4": "4567"}.

phone_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the phone number used for the order.
